proof:
Source: Lemma A (step 1) of the parent proof of dtc_bc_codim_zero — the density part of the Constancy Theorem (Simon Ch. 6, 2.34, chapter-06.txt lines 571–600), specialized to integer multiplicity currents — with all details filled in. No sibling is used.
Notation. Hⁿ := μHE[n] and Lⁿ := volume on ℝⁿ = Euclid n; Mathlib EuclideanSpace.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_eq_volume n gives Hⁿ = Lⁿ. b := EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ (an orthonormal basis), e := ⇑b, and D := b.toBasis.det, the alternating n-linear form with D(e) = 1 (Module.Basis.det_self). D is continuous (D(v) is the determinant of the coordinate matrix of v, Module.Basis.det_apply, a continuous function of v by Continuous.matrix_det), so D defines an n-covector e* ∈ Covector (Euclid n) n with e*(v) = D(v) and e*(e) = 1.
1. Fix R = (M, θ, ξ) : IMRep V n with R.Represents X (definition of IsIntegerMultiplicity). Thus X(ω) = ∫_M θ(y)·ξ(y)(ω(y)) dHⁿ(y) for every ω ∈ TestFormOn V n (IMRep.action); M is a measurable subset of V; θ : ℝⁿ → ℕ is measurable with ∫⁻_{M∩K} θ dHⁿ < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ V (field locallyIntegrable_mult); ξ is AEStronglyMeasurable for Hⁿ⌞M.
2. Every n-covector α satisfies α(v) = α(e)·D(v) for all v : Fin n → ℝⁿ: apply Mathlib AlternatingMap.eq_smul_basis_det to the alternating map underlying α and the basis b.toBasis.
3. Let y ∈ M be a point at which the `orients` property of R holds (this is the case for Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. y): there is a subspace Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M y Q and IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ(y)) Q. The first gives finrank Q = n (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt.finrank_eq) = finrank ℝⁿ, so Q = ⊤ (Submodule.eq_top_of_finrank_eq). The second gives an orthonormal τ : Fin n → ℝⁿ with span(range τ) = Q = ⊤ such that either ξ(y)(α) = α(τ) for all α, or ξ(y)(α) = −α(τ) for all α. Since τ is orthonormal and spans ⊤, it is an orthonormal basis (OrthonormalBasis.mk with OrthonormalBasis.coe_mk), and the change-of-basis determinant between two orthonormal bases is ±1 (Mathlib OrthonormalBasis.det_to_matrix_orthonormalBasis_real); thus D(τ) = b.toBasis.det τ ∈ {1, −1}. By step 2, α(τ) = α(e)·D(τ). Hence there is s(y) ∈ {1, −1} with ξ(y)(α) = s(y)·α(e) for every α; taking α = e* gives s(y) = ξ(y)(e*).
4. Define σ : ℝⁿ → ℝ by σ(y) := ξ(y)(e*). By step 3, for Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. y: σ(y) ∈ {1, −1} and ξ(y)(α) = σ(y)·α(e) for every n-covector α. σ is the composition of ξ with the continuous linear map "evaluation at e*" (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ e*), hence AEStronglyMeasurable for Hⁿ⌞M; let σ̃ be a measurable function with σ̃ = σ Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. (AEStronglyMeasurable.mk).
5. Define g : ℝⁿ → ℤ by g(y) := θ(y) if y ∈ M and σ̃(y) ≥ 0; g(y) := −θ(y) if y ∈ M and σ̃(y) < 0; g(y) := 0 if y ∉ M. Then g is measurable (M and {σ̃ ≥ 0} are measurable sets, θ is measurable), g = 0 outside M, |g(y)| ≤ θ(y)·1_M(y) for every y, and for Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. y we have σ̃(y) = σ(y) ∈ {1, −1}, hence (g(y) : ℝ) = θ(y)·σ(y).
6. Local integrability. For a compact K ⊆ V: ∫⁻_K |g| dLⁿ ≤ ∫⁻_K θ·1_M dHⁿ = ∫⁻_{M∩K} θ dHⁿ < ∞ (step 5, Hⁿ = Lⁿ, step 1); with the measurability of g, g is integrable on every compact subset of V. Since V is open (hence locally closed), integrability on every compact subset of V is equivalent to LocallyIntegrableOn (fun y => (g y : ℝ)) V volume (locallyIntegrableOn_iff with hV.isLocallyClosed).
7. Formula. Let ω ∈ TestFormOn V n. For Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. y, steps 4–5 give θ(y)·ξ(y)(ω(y)) = θ(y)·σ(y)·ω(y)(e) = g(y)·ω(y)(e). Hence X(ω) = ∫_M θ·ξ(ω) dHⁿ = ∫_M g·ω(e) dHⁿ (integral_congr_ae for Hⁿ⌞M; no integrability is needed for this step). Because g = 0 outside M, ∫_M g·ω(e) dHⁿ = ∫_{ℝⁿ} g·ω(e) dHⁿ (setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero), and Hⁿ = Lⁿ turns this into X(ω) = ∫ g(y)·ω(y)(e) dLⁿ(y). Together with step 6 this proves the statement. ∎

key_steps: Fix a representation (M, θ, ξ) of X; the approximate tangent space of M ⊆ ℝⁿ is ℝⁿ, so a.e. ξ(y) = ±e₁∧…∧eₙ (orthonormal n-frames have determinant ±1): ξ(y)(α) = σ(y)α(e) with σ(y) = ξ(y)(e*) ∈ {±1}.
g := θ·sign(σ̃)·1_M (σ̃ a measurable version of σ) is ℤ-valued, measurable and |g| ≤ θ1_M, so g ∈ L¹_loc(V) by locallyIntegrable_mult (Hⁿ = Lⁿ).
X(ω) = ∫_M θξ(ω) dHⁿ = ∫_M gω(e) dHⁿ = ∫ g ω(e) dLⁿ (a.e. equality on M, g = 0 off M, Hⁿ = Lⁿ).
